validation_results.failure: Squirtle's lineage fainted during Route 24 recovery Center entry.
validation_results.diagnosis: The recovery planner recognized the need for a Center but began a long field walk while the only party member was poisoned. Generation I poison-step damage exhausted the remaining HP before the doorway.

interpretation.planner_result: All objective decisions before the failure were model-authorized; the failure occurred in low-level status-aware travel rather than objective selection.
interpretation.evaluation_result: The preregistered v4 series failed its five-run completion contract and is retired. The exposed-seed repair completion cannot replace a held-out result.
interpretation.repair_result: Route 24 Center recovery now cures observed poison at the post-battle boundary before any field movement can apply another poison tick.
interpretation.next_gate: Run the unchanged repaired source and model on the fresh v5 validation schedules, leaving v5 test schedules sealed.
